ios.desc:
Unleash Your Creativity with Doodle: Where Every Line Tells a Story

Discover the joy of digital drawing with Doodle, the ultimate creative companion for artists of all ages and skill levels. With over 2 million downloads and an "App of the Day" feature, Doodle is revolutionizing the way people express themselves through art.

Key Features:

- Intuitive drawing tools
- Pencil support for precision drawing and lettering
- Multi-platform compatibility
- Backup to access your creations across all devices
- Show & Tell: Record and share your drawing process as a video
- Family Sharing: One purchase for up to 6 family members

Privacy First:

- No ads, no tracking, no data collection
- No accounts, profiles, or social media integration
- No third-party SDKs or analytics

Perfect for:

- Education and learning
- Travel journaling
- Note-taking and brainstorming
- Creating stunning illustrations
- Designing flowcharts and wireframes
- Encouraging children's creativity

Accessibility:

- Native support for 30+ languages, including RTL languages like Arabic and Hebrew

Join millions of happy users who are exploring endless creative possibilities with Doodle. Whether you're a professional artist, a curious beginner, or a parent looking for a fun, educational app for your children, Doodle offers a seamless and enjoyable drawing experience for everyone.

Download Doodle today and start your artistic journey – because every line tells a story, and yours is waiting to be drawn.

Privacy policy: https://doodle.app/privacy
Terms of use: https://doodle.app/terms

quotes.text:
I wrote this tool (started on Thursday) called Doodle that is designed to give kids a quick drawing canvas. It's a super simple app that I made for my son who kept drawing over all of my Apple notes. You can draw, then press the button in the top right to quickly erase your drawing (Like an Etch A Sketch).

Someone nerd-sniped me and I added in the ability to record a video as well. Technically, you could use it to do quick 5-10 minute drawing/narrated lessons and export them for educational purposes.

Site: https://joeblau.com/doodle/

Source: https://github.com/joeblau/doodle

AppStore: https://itunes.apple.com/app/id1503601939
